newsitem.title: BULGARIA: Bulgaria lev falls to 1,530-1,590 per dlr at close.
newsitem.headline: Bulgaria lev falls to 1,530-1,590 per dlr at close.

text.p: The Bulgarian lev closed at 1,530-1,590 per dollar in low interbank volume, down from 1,400 at the opening and 1,450-1,480 at midday due to prevailing dollar demand, dealers said.
The lev closed at 1,300-1,450 on Wednesday.
"Large final clients were bidding for dollars amid low supply and the lev slid despite central bank decision to support it by curbing banks' lev liquidity," one dealer said.
The central bank on Wednesday barred commercial banks from using minimum required reserves for emergency refinancing.
The measure went into force today, and limited trade to low volumes, dealers said. -- Anastas Petrov, Sofia Newsroom, 359-2-84561
